seo_title: Wego Case Study: Middle East Travel Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 16,235 pieces of travel media across 6 Middle East markets and 8 brands, finding 6 traveller personas and gaps such as luxury travel in KSA.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Travel · Middle East
h1: Wego and 7 rivals lean on adventure and may miss luxury travel in KSA
h1_em: and may miss luxury travel in KSA
lede: For Wego, SOMIN read 16,235 pieces of paid and organic media from 8 travel brands across Bahrain, KSA, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the UAE, covering 2023 to 2024. It clustered the content into 6 personas, 6 topics, 6 relatability themes and 6 challenges, then broke each down by market and brand. Adventure Explorers was the largest persona, with 1,125 unique media.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 2023 to 2024 · Middle East

challenge.title: Wego against 7 travel brands in 6 Middle East markets
challenge.body: Wego competes with regional and local travel brands across 6 Middle East markets, from ITL Group and Dadabhai to Regency, Cozmo and Almulla. The study asked who the region's travel brands were talking to, what they talked about, how they tried to relate and which challenges they tried to solve.

approach.title: Personas, topics, relatability and challenges, by market
points: Gathered paid and organic media for 8 brands across 6 markets, with country filters applied to ads.
Clustered the content into personas, topics, relatability themes and challenges with SOMIN's semantic models.
Compared every cluster by market, then zoomed in on each brand's focus within each market.
Closed with a systematic process: understand the market, generate angles, adopt, test and learn, and reinforce what works.

findings_title: Adventure dominates, KSA luxury lags and Kuwait has specialists

findings.title: Adventure is the default
findings.body: The most common persona across the region is adventurers: Adventure Explorers accounts for 1,125 unique media. Family Explorers is second in every market except Kuwait.

findings.title: Luxury in KSA is underused
findings.body: Luxury Adventurers ranks 3rd to 4th in most markets but 5th in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, which suggests the tracked brands may not be capitalising on luxury travel in KSA.

findings.title: Kuwait has specialists
findings.body: In Kuwait, KAPICO and Regency focus heavily on luxury personas and Alghanim Travel on Thrifty Explorers, while Family Explorers is not as crowded.

delivered.title: 6 traveller personas and 6 topics, split by market and brand
points: Media counts for 8 brands in each of Bahrain, KSA, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the UAE
6 traveller personas: Adventure Explorers, Luxury Adventurers and the Soulful, Thrifty, Family and Festive Explorers
6 topics, led by global travel destinations (491 unique media) and travel offers and packages (456)
6 relatability themes and 6 challenges, each split by market and brand
A test-and-learn process for turning the findings into communication directions

quote.text: This shows that the tracked brands used to understand the market may not be capitalizing on luxury travel in KSA.

outcome.title: Wego can test luxury in KSA and families in Kuwait
outcome.body: The study points to lanes the tracked brands leave open, such as luxury travel in KSA, Family Explorers in Kuwait and Thrifty Explorers in the UAE. Its process is to generate angles from these findings, test and learn, then reinforce what works.

faq.q: Which markets and brands did the Wego study cover?
faq.a: Bahrain, KSA, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the UAE, and 8 travel brands: Wego, ITL Group, Dadabhai, Alghanim Travel, KAPICO, Regency, Cozmo and Almulla.
It can. Some pages are regional, so media may be duplicated across market datasets, and the total reflects that duplication.
SOMIN clustered the media with an X-means algorithm on ADA embeddings using its audience semantic model, then compared each persona by market and brand.
